blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-ops-1 (Payment call has no timeout and can hang the checkout forever) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-ops-2 (Unbounded retry of a non-idempotent charge can duplicate payments) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-ops-3 (Failures are swallowed silently and never surface to the caller or the logs) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Pass an explicit `timeout=` (connect and read) to `requests.post`, read from configuration, so a stalled provider fails fast instead of blocking the checkout worker indefinitely.
findings.title: Payment call has no timeout and can hang the checkout forever

findings.recommendation: Bound the retries (a small maximum count) with exponential backoff and jitter, retry only transient errors (timeouts, connection errors, 5xx/429), and send an idempotency key derived from `order_id` so a retry after a lost response cannot charge the order twice; raise once retries are exhausted.
findings.title: Unbounded retry of a non-idempotent charge can duplicate payments

findings.recommendation: Log each failed attempt as a structured event (order_id, attempt, HTTP status, provider error code — no card or credential data), and raise an actionable exception after the last attempt. Permanent errors such as a 4xx decline must not be retried at all: today a declined card loops forever with no trace.
findings.title: Failures are swallowed silently and never surface to the caller or the logs

findings.recommendation: Read the endpoint from the environment or configuration so it can be pointed at a sandbox or switched without a release.
findings.title: Provider URL is hard-coded
